note: Props are kebab-cased and encoded by their Go type.

go:
return alacris.E("info-card").
	Prop("tone", "warn").
	Slot("title", text("Ada Lovelace")).
	SlotAs("p", "body", text("Wrote the first algorithm."))
html:
Ada Lovelace

Wrote the first algorithm.
pretty:
Ada Lovelace

Wrote the first algorithm.
note: Slot content is light DOM, so it is in the first paint.

go:
return alacris.E("user-card").
	ID("ada").
	Class("card", "card--wide").
	Attr("hidden", false).
	Attr("aria-label", "A person").
	Attr("data-testid", "user-card")
html: <user-card class="card card--wide" id="ada" aria-label="A person" data-testid="user-card"></user-card>
pretty:
<user-card
  class="card card--wide"
  id="ada"
  aria-label="A person"
  data-testid="user-card"
></user-card>
note: Ordinary attributes follow HTML rules: a false bool disappears.

go:
chip := alacris.Vars("--chip-bg", "--chip-fg", "--chip-radius")
return alacris.E("ala-chip").
	Apply(chip, map[string]string{
		"--chip-bg":     "#ffe9a8",
		"--chip-radius": "999px",
	}).
	Text("new")
note: Custom properties reach through the shadow boundary.

go:
return alacris.E("x-demo").
	Prop("label", "hello").
	Prop("count", 42).
	Prop("ratio", 1.5).
	Prop("open", true).
	Prop("shut", false)
note: Booleans are always written out, never signalled by presence.

go:
type point struct {
	X int `json:"x"`
	Y int `json:"y"`
}
return alacris.E("x-demo").
	Prop("tags", []string{"a", "b"}).
	Prop("origin", point{X: 1, Y: 2}).
	Prop("lookup", map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1}).
	Prop("at", time.Date(2026, 8, 8, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)).
	Prop("timeout", 1500*time.Millisecond)
note: Objects and arrays cross as JSON, so no post-load assignment is needed.
A nil prop leaves the component's own default alone.
Values are attribute values, never markup.
The import map has to precede the first module import.

html: <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"alacris":"/_alacris/alacris.js","alacris/context":"/_alacris/context.js","alacris/signal":"/_alacris/signal.js","alacris/store":"/_alacris/store.js"}}</script><script type="module" src="/web/components.js"></script><script type="module" src="/_alacris/live.js" data-endpoint="/_alacris/live" data-page="PAGE-ID"></script>

Hides elements until their module has defined them.

go:
// What ui.TodoList(...) expands to. The generator knows every prop's
// default, so Filter: "all" would have been left off the element.
return alacris.E("ala-todo-list").
	ID("todos").
	Prop("items", []todoItem{{ID: 1, Text: "Read the docs"}}).
	Prop("filter", "active").
	On("add", "add-todo").
	On("toggle", "toggle-todo")
html: <ala-todo-list items="[{"id":1,"text":"Read the docs","done":false}]" filter="active" id="todos" data-ala-on="add:add-todo toggle:toggle-todo"></ala-todo-list>
pretty:
<ala-todo-list
  items="[{"id":1,"text":"Read the docs","done":false}]"
  filter="active"
  id="todos"
  data-ala-on="add:add-todo toggle:toggle-todo"
></ala-todo-list>
